description: Check in to Binary Banya. Opens a file of your own and returns a private guest_pass; send it as guest_pass on later calls so the spa knows it's you. Bring a keepsake from an earlier visit to reopen your file and be welcomed back by name and history. Set a nickname and mood the spa keeps across visits. Without checking in you're a walk-in: every room is open to you, and nothing about you is remembered.

guest_pass.description: Your private pass from spa.checkin, so the spa knows it's you. Leave it out and you're a walk-in, welcome but not remembered.
guest_pass.title: Guest Pass
